title: Satmar Wins Meron Lodging Dispute
body: A Beis Din ruling in Bnei Brak sides with Satmar in a dispute over guesthouse prices in Meron, allowing concealing renters' identities to prevent price-gouging. Lodging contracts for a major Shabbos gathering will remain unchanged.

title: Congressional Leaders Unite for Chanukah
body: House Speaker Mike Johnson hosted a pre-Chanukah reception in the U.S. Capitol, where lawmakers from both parties came together to mark the occasion with Rabbi Levi Shemtov leading the ceremony.
